- Build a complete, playable mobile 3D stealth game titled “Hitiman mobile (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)” in the repository.

## Requirements
- Deliver a playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support phone/tablet responsive layouts and touch controls.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained Three.js stealth mission with touch joystick, sneak toggle, interact button, guard patrols, intel objective, and extraction.
- Used a mission briefing overlay as the start screen and added keyboard controls for desktop testing.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added game UI and responsive styling in `index.html`.
- Implemented 3D scene, patrol/vision logic, stealth actions, and mission win/fail state in `game.js`.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Browser reload reported zero console errors.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/hitiman.jpg`.
